stages.oracle: A first-time visitor understands what Jovie does for them and sees what the paid plan adds over Free; one working next step.
The canary signs up with email OTP and is signed in as itself; no waitlist wall, invite error or blank Restoring screen.
Onboarding finds the canary's stand-in artist and shows that artist's real releases, not a placeholder; the handle chosen is the handle kept.
The canary's public profile is live with real releases and smart links that resolve; AI replies answer the question asked (no quota wall or error body).
Upgrade shows the live Artist Presence price and trial, Stripe test-mode checkout completes, and the paid capabilities unlock for the canary.

paidOutcome.freeAlternative: Jovie Free (profile, smart links, release pages, fan capture) or a free link-in-bio
